prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a horizontally scrolling BACKGROUND PANORAMA behind a food truck in a 1-bit Playdate game, very wide 3:1 landscape.
Black-and-white West Coast roadside scenery seen from the side at vehicle height: a low distant ridge, sparse low flat-roof roadside buildings, a few tall slim palm trees, sparse roadside bushes and a couple of wooden utility poles. Strong silhouettes, economical scratchy ink outlines and light coarse halftone shading, matching a gritty monochrome food-truck game. The setting is broad sunlit open roadside, not a crowded city.
Composition for side-scrolling: all verticals upright, no perspective road disappearing into the distance. Small variation across the panorama. Baseline runs perfectly horizontally at 82% image height. Palm fronds reach high toward 8%-18% height, roofs sit around 55%-75%. Keep the top mostly clean white sky, no sun, no clouds or text. Leave the leftmost and rightmost 8% mostly blank white above the identical flat baseline so repeated copies can join without a visible seam. No frame.
The near road, truck and foreground are added separately, so DO NOT DRAW ANY VEHICLES, people, characters, foreground road, road markings or food-truck signage. No logos or words. Strict black and white, black ink / sparse dotted texture only, no gradients, color, gray washes, glossy shading or smooth 3D. Shapes must read when downsampled; avoid fine dense noisy detail. The truck will obscure much of the lower center, so distribute the recognizable palms and low buildings across the full width. Standalone scenery layer on an opaque clean white background.
